case.title: The Cruise Ship Mystery
case.introduction: Tonight at The Aurora Voyager, the ruin of the big event of the evening has turned the evening upside down. No one is allowed to leave. 4 guests are still here, and each one is hiding something. One of them is not who they say they are. Find that person.
case.crime: The ruin of the big event of the evening
case.target_fake_identity: Rowan Okafor, a piano player people trust
case.escape_plan: Rowan Okafor plans to sneak out while everyone is confused, and be gone before the police arrive.

rooms.name: The Grand Lobby
rooms.description: A huge hall with stone floors and a wide staircase.

rooms.name: The Lounge
rooms.description: Soft yellow light, leather chairs, and slow music playing.

rooms.name: The Dining Room
rooms.description: A long table, still set for dinner.

rooms.name: The Private Study
rooms.description: Book shelves, a heavy desk, and one locked drawer.

rooms.name: The Terrace Garden
rooms.description: Cool night air, tall bushes, and a view of the water.

rooms.name: The Guest Rooms
rooms.description: A hallway of numbered doors. Most are half open.

characters.name: Rowan Okafor
characters.background: A piano player with a messy past.
characters.secret: Rowan owes a lot of money from betting.
characters.goal: Rowan wants to keep their good name safe, no matter what.
characters.alibi: Says they were in The Terrace Garden when it happened.
knowledge: Knows exactly how the crime was done.
lies: Says they never went into the room where the main clue was found.
Says all their papers are real.

characters.name: Lucas Reyes
characters.personality: closed off and quick to defend
characters.background: A money investor with a messy past.
characters.secret: Lucas was taking money from another guest to keep a secret quiet.
characters.goal: Lucas wants to find out who is watching them.
characters.alibi: Says they were in The Private Study when it happened.
knowledge: Saw Rowan Okafor acting strange near The Lounge.
Heard an angry argument earlier that night.

characters.personality: closed off and quick to defend

characters.secret: Diego was in a secret relationship with the victim.
characters.goal: Diego wants to find out who is watching them.
characters.alibi: Says they were in The Grand Lobby when it happened.
knowledge: Saw Rowan Okafor acting strange near The Terrace Garden.

characters.name: Ronan Novak
characters.background: A lab scientist with a messy past.
characters.secret: Ronan was taking money from another guest to keep a secret quiet.
characters.goal: Ronan wants to keep their good name safe, no matter what.
characters.alibi: Says they were in The Grand Lobby when it happened.
knowledge: Saw Rowan Okafor acting strange near The Dining Room.

lies: Hides one thing: Ronan was in a secret relationship with the victim.

timeline.description: The crime happens: the ruin of the big event of the evening.
The alarm goes off. No one may leave.
Rowan Okafor is seen moving toward a side door.

evidence.name: a wine glass
evidence.description: A half-full glass. The drink smells bitter.

evidence.name: a cloth with blood on it
evidence.description: A fine cloth with two letters sewn on it and a dark stain.

evidence.name: a fake passport
evidence.description: It looks real, but the year of birth is a little bit wrong.

evidence.name: a hidden key
evidence.description: A small brass key taped under a drawer.

evidence.name: a torn train ticket
evidence.description: A ticket ripped in two. The time on it is earlier than someone said.

hidden_clues: Rowan Okafor's story about where they were does not match the a wine glass.
Two guests say they have never met, but a photo shows they have.

solution.target_true_identity: A wanted criminal pretending to be a piano player
solution.reasoning: Rowan Okafor is the hidden person. The main clues (a wine glass, a cloth with blood on it) put them at the scene and show their story is not true. Their papers are fake too.

state.current_objective: At The Aurora Voyager tonight, 4 guests are trapped — and one is lying about who they are. Look for clues, compare their stories, and unmask the one behind the ruin of the big event of the evening. Some guests lie. Check their stories carefully.
